## Runs 6–7 — raw SdH spot checks before interpretation

Both completed on the sole hardwired B_1–B_2 Rxx pair at D ≈ 0. Run 6 swept n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻² from 0 to 10 T; run 7 swept n = −1.2×10¹² cm⁻² from 10 to 0.3 T. The plotted traces use `open_run` and the measured 10 nA bias; no background removal or FFT is applied here.

from hera.analysis import open_run, summarize_run
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 7), constrained_layout=True)
for i, (file_id, n) in enumerate(((6, +3.2), (7, -1.2))):
    r = open_run(f'data/{file_id}')
    print(summarize_run(r))
    B = r.col('magnet_field')
    R = r.col('sr1_X') / 1e-8  # sr1 unity gain, live 1 V / 100 MΩ = 10 nA
    T = r.col('T_sample')
    print(f'run {file_id}: Rxx [{R.min():.1f}, {R.max():.1f}] Ω; '
          f'T_sample [{T.min():.3f}, {T.max():.3f}] K; '
          f'TG/BG median currents {np.median(r.col("k_2400_tg_curr"))*1e12:.1f}/'
          f'{np.median(r.col("k_2400_bg_curr"))*1e12:.1f} pA')
    ax[i].plot(B, R, lw=1)
    ax[i].set(title=f'Run {file_id}: n = {n:+.1f}×10¹² cm⁻², D ≈ 0',
              xlabel='B (T)', ylabel='raw Rxx (Ω)')
    ax[i].grid(alpha=.25)
plt.show()

## Runs 6–7 — spot-check frequency read and fan decision

The raw electron trace has oscillations without rail or sustained gate-current rise. `sdh_onset` returns 0.30 T on its ≈7.1 T carrier but marks this **censored at the record edge**; the ≈22 T component starts near 1.36 T. In a 0.85–10 T FFT the prominent ≈7.4, 14.9, 22.3 and 29.7 T lines are close to 1×–4× multiples, so the spot alone cannot distinguish a genuine second pocket from harmonics or breakdown; the ABAB model at this density predicts ≈7.3 and 25.8 T, while the single-pocket line is F_L ≈33.1 T (geometry-prior scale). The hole trace has a measured ≈0.71 T onset and several lines, but n = −1.2×10¹² lies in the model's near-CNP balanced-pair exception and cannot anchor a clean stacking call. Next: an electron-side D ≈ 0 fan across density to test whether the ≈22 T line follows its own Onsager curve or tracks 3× the low line.

from hera.analysis import open_run, sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 7), constrained_layout=True)
for i, (file_id, n, b_lo) in enumerate(((6, +3.2, 0.85), (7, -1.2, 0.7))):
    r = open_run(f'data/{file_id}')
    B, R = r.col('magnet_field'), r.col('sr1_X') / 1e-8
    onset = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=5000)
    print(f'run {file_id}: onset {onset.onset_b:.2f} T '
          f'({onset.onset_freq:.2f} T carrier); '
          f'tones '+', '.join(f'{t.freq:.1f} T' for t in onset.tones))
    f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(b_lo, 10),
                      bg_degree=5, window='hann', log=False, nfft=4096)
    y = spec[0]
    peaks, _ = find_peaks(y, prominence=max(y[(f > 3) & (f < 45)]) * .04)
    peaks = sorted((j for j in peaks if 3 < f[j] < 45), key=lambda j: y[j], reverse=True)[:6]
    print('  FFT peaks: '+', '.join(f'{f[j]:.1f} T' for j in peaks))
    fl = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n) * 1e16))
    ax[i].plot(f, y, lw=1, label=f'run {file_id}, B≥{b_lo:g} T')
    ax[i].axvline(fl, color='k', ls='--', lw=1, label=f'F_L={fl:.1f} T')
    if file_id == 6:
        for j, model_f in enumerate((7.3, 25.8)):
            ax[i].axvline(model_f, color='tab:red', ls=':', lw=1,
                          label='ABAB model' if j == 0 else None)
    ax[i].set(xlim=(0, 45), xlabel='frequency (T)', ylabel='FFT magnitude',
              title=f'n = {n:+.1f}×10¹² cm⁻²; B-space detrend, Hann window')
    ax[i].legend()
    ax[i].grid(alpha=.25)
plt.show()

## HERA — electron D ≈ 0 Landau fan for the stacking call (`landau-fan-vti`)

> **05:25** · Electron D=0 FS-count fan: n +2.4 to +3.2e12 cm^-2, B 0.85 to 10 T, 110x24 uniform 1/B, 3 s fast dwell, sr1 50 uV · **ETA ~09:45** (≈4h20m)

Runs 6–7 and the run-5 calibration favor the electron side: run 6 has strong SdH at n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², while the reachable hole side is only −1.2×10¹² and lies in the investigation's near-CNP ambiguity; its electron lines near 7.4, 14.9, 22.3, 29.7 T can be harmonics, so density evolution is the needed discriminator (ana cells 14–17). The paired-gate line covers n = +2.4…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² at calibrated D = 0 (Vtg ≈ +0.754…+0.984 V, Vbg ≈ +0.870…+1.166 V), with 24 density points and 110 field rows uniform in 1/B from 0.85 to 10 T: Δn = 0.0348×10¹² (< half the 0.082×10¹² ray spacing at 0.85 T), Δ(1/B) = 0.00988 T⁻¹ (3.1 samples per F_L,max ≈ 33.1 T period), δF ≈ 0.93 T, and ≈5.2 cycles of the ABAB-model 4.8 T partner at the low-density edge. The 0.85 T floor keeps that partner resolvable despite run 6's 0.30 T onset being censored; densities below +2.4×10¹² and the hole side are excluded because the former bring low-frequency and CNP ambiguity plus higher sensitivity risk, while the latter cannot reach the recipe's |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² design band within the validators. Fixed 50 µV sensitivity gives 5 kΩ full scale at 10 nA, versus runs 6/7 maxima 523/576 Ω and the run-5 CNP ridge <3 kΩ; τ = 0.3 s at 24 dB/oct implies 3 s fast delay (10τ), and run 6's 921-point/2.01 h timing plus the 73 min bare field traverse and paired-gate overhead price this at ≈4 h 20 min.

Before hardware moves the cell verifies live/base thermometry, zero-ish field and Si voltage, heater/output state, drive, filter, pacing, and validators; it checks the gate voltages and leakage after the initial set. Checkpoints: the first 2–3 landed rows for current, rail, T, and field tracking (abort immediately if wrong); then rows near 2, 4, 6 and 8 T for partial per-column structure and continued low-leakage/no-clipping judgment. The fan ends at 10 T and n = +2.4×10¹² cm⁻² so a follow-up can ride the magnet downward after the data read.

# Electron-side D = 0 Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`), run-5 in-session calibration.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD
from hera.analysis import field_invB, luttinger_frequency

CAL_FAN = dict(c_tg=2.7960593093052633e-3, c_bg=2.160696465377614e-3,
               n_offset=-0.08937933224099137, D_offset=-0.013)
n_line = np.linspace(3.2, 2.4, 24)  # 1e12 cm^-2; begin at high n, away from CNP
D_line = np.zeros_like(n_line)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(n_line, D_line, CAL_FAN['c_tg'], CAL_FAN['c_bg'],
                                CAL_FAN['n_offset'], CAL_FAN['D_offset'])
B_vec = field_invB(0.85, 10.0, 110)
assert np.all((TG_MIN <= Vtgs) & (Vtgs <= TG_MAX))
assert np.all((BG_MIN <= Vbgs) & (Vbgs <= BG_MAX))
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
for i in (0, -1):
    nr, Dr = calc_nD(Vtgs[i], Vbgs[i], CAL_FAN['c_tg'], CAL_FAN['c_bg'],
                     CAL_FAN['n_offset'], CAL_FAN['D_offset'])
    assert abs(nr - n_line[i]) < 1e-6 and abs(Dr) < 1e-6
print(f'fan: {len(B_vec)} B rows {B_vec[0]:.3f}->{B_vec[-1]:.3f} T; '
      f'{len(n_line)} n points {n_line[0]:+.2f}->{n_line[-1]:+.2f}e12; '
      f'Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f} V, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}->{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V')
print(f'du={abs(1/B_vec[1]-1/B_vec[0]):.5f} T^-1; dn={abs(n_line[1]-n_line[0]):.5f}e12; '
      f'F_L,max={float(luttinger_frequency(n_line[0]*1e16)):.2f} T')

# Preconditions: only state inherited rather than set by this cell.
assert_thermometry_live('T_sample', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_sample'],
                        max_age=15, max_period=12)
assert_thermometry_live('T_vaporizer', VTI.temp_logfile_candidates['T_vaporizer'],
                        max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts, _Tv, _B, _Si = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field(), k_si()
_slope, _tau, _drive = sr1.filter_slope(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.amplitude()
_sr, _vr = heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range()
print(f'precondition: Ts={_Ts:.3f} K [1.0,1.5], Tv={_Tv:.3f} K [<1.6], '
      f'B={_B:+.4f} T [|B|<0.05], Si={_Si:+.3f} V [0], '
      f'heaters={_sr}/{_vr} [0/0], PS/output={magnet.persistent_switch_on()}/{magnet.output_enabled()} [True/True], '
      f'drive={_drive:.3f} V [1], tau={_tau:.3f} s [0.3], slope={_slope} dB/oct [24], '
      f'NPLC tg/bg={k_2400_tg.nplci()}/{k_2400_bg.nplci()} [1/1]')
assert 1.0 <= _Ts <= 1.5 and _Tv < 1.6 and abs(_Tv - _Ts) < 0.6
assert abs(_B) < 0.05 and abs(_Si) < 0.01 and _sr == 0 and _vr == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert abs(_drive - 1.0) < 0.01 and abs(_tau - 0.3) < 1e-6 and _slope == 24
assert k_2400_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_2400_bg.nplci() == 1
assert (TG_MIN, TG_MAX, BG_MIN, BG_MAX, B_SESSION_CAP) == (-0.3, 1.0, -1.3, 2.0, 10.0)
assert (k_tg.volt.vals._min_value, k_tg.volt.vals._max_value) == (TG_MIN, TG_MAX)
assert (k_bg.volt.vals._min_value, k_bg.volt.vals._max_value) == (BG_MIN, BG_MAX)
assert (magnet.field.vals._min_value, magnet.field.vals._max_value) == (-B_SESSION_CAP, B_SESSION_CAP)

sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)  # 5 kΩ full scale at I_bias=10 nA
mc = dict(meas_config)
mc['Si (V)'] = _Si
mc['sample_temperature:'] = _Ts
mc['comments'] = ('landau-fan-vti electron: n +3.2 to +2.4e12 cm^-2, D=0 V/nm '
                  '(run-5 calibration), B +0.85 to +10 T, 110 uniform-1/B rows, '
                  '24 n points, fast delay 3 s, sr1 50 uV')
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment('tetralayer-stacking-fs-count')
s.add_comment(f'electron D=0 fan; n {n_line[0]:+.2f} to {n_line[-1]:+.2f}e12 cm^-2; '
              f'B {B_vec[0]:+.2f} to {B_vec[-1]:+.2f} T; 110x24 uniform 1/B; '
              f'Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} to {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f} V, '
              f'Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} to {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; '
              'run-5 CNP/D calibration; fast_delay 3 s; sr1 sensitivity 50 uV')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, float(Vbgs[0]))
s.ramp(k_tg.volt, float(Vtgs[0]))
interruptible_sleep(10)
_Itg, _Ibg = k_tg.curr(), k_bg.curr()
print(f'gate-set readback: Vtg={k_tg.volt():+.4f}/{Vtgs[0]:+.4f} V, '
      f'Vbg={k_bg.volt():+.4f}/{Vbgs[0]:+.4f} V; '
      f'Itg={_Itg*1e12:+.1f} pA, Ibg={_Ibg*1e12:+.1f} pA')
assert abs(k_tg.volt()-Vtgs[0]) < 0.01 and abs(k_bg.volt()-Vbgs[0]) < 0.01
assert abs(_Itg) < 1e-9 and abs(_Ibg) < 1e-9

# Row layout: time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, Itg, Ibg, sr0.X/P, sr1.X/P.
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot('time', T_sample)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)
s.plot('time', sr0.X); s.plot('time', sr0.P)
s.plot('time', sr1.X); s.plot('time', sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X)

def fan_quality_guard(station, data):
    itg, ibg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    rxx_v = abs(float(data[9]))
    if itg > 1e-9 or ibg > 1e-9 or rxx_v > 0.9 * 50e-6:
        print(f'FAN TRIP B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f} V: '
              f'|Itg|={itg*1e12:.1f} pA, |Ibg|={ibg*1e12:.1f} pA, '
              f'|sr1.X|={rxx_v*1e6:.2f} uV')
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_quality_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                 slow_delay=0, fast_delay=3.0)
print(f'fan complete: B={magnet.field():+.3f} T, '
      f'Vtg={k_tg.volt():+.4f} V, Vbg={k_bg.volt():+.4f} V')

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing.
